output.summary: Denial for bariatric surgery is based on exclusion under Section 7.4. Under V2025 the service can be covered if the member has a BMI of 40+ and completes a six‑month supervised weight‑loss program. The claim only includes a BMI record; the supervised program record is missing, so an appeal is possible once that evidence is submitted. Prior V2025 cases HC-024 and HC-025 were overturned after providing both required items.
